tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /nged rang gi 'dra 'bag yid bzhin nor bu'i gzungs gzhug gi dkar chag bzhugs lags// oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ rgyal ba zhes pa shing pho rta lo zla ba bzhi pa'i yar tshes la/ nged rang gi 'dra 'bag yid bzhin nor bu gsar du bzhengs pa'i gzungs bzhugs pa la/ thog mar/ dbu gzungs/ bar gzungs/ pad gzungs/ gnod sbyin 'khor lo sogs cha tshang zhing bzhugs che ba/ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag rnam rgyal rab brtan pas bzhengs pa'i sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i sku brnyan sngags 'chang nyid kyi phyag nas brgya tshar zhugs pa'i byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba/ rje btsun gong ma'i dam rdzas kun 'dus phon che ba/ sngags 'chang yab sras gsum gyi dam rdzas stong rdo/ brgya rdo/ bcu rdo sogs dang / sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' dbang rgyal gyi 'bum rdo/ nged rang gi dam rdzas ril bu'i bsgrub pa tshar bcu gcig pa'i dus kyi 'bum rdo sogs dang / gzhan yang rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje lha mchog seṅge / tshar pa chos rje/ rje bsod nams chos 'phel sogs bla ma gong ma'i gdung tsha phon che ba/ rje btsun gong ma lnga'i sku thang spar ma byin rlabs can/ grub mchog bsod nams dbang po dang / yab rje chos kyi rgyal po la lam 'bras bla ma brgyud pas bskor ba rje de gnyis rang gi phyag nas ma'i bris thang byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba/ yang sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po/ grub mchog bsod nams dbang po/ yab rje chos kyi rgyal po/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags rnams kyi gsung shog phyag bris ma sa bre gang lhag tsam/ tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa rje nags dgon pa sbyin pa grags pa'i sku gzan bub ma nyams pa sogs byin rlabs kyis phyur bur gtams pa la nged rang gis rab gnas shis brjod rgyas pa smin grub tu bgyis te/ byang phyogs nor 'dzin gyi khyon na 'khod pa'i skye dgu mtha' dag gi mchod yul mtshungs pa med pa mus rta mo gling kha bde ba can gyi gtsug lag khang du lha mi'i bsod nams kyi zhing dam par bzhugs su gsol ba 'di 'phral dang yun du dge legs su gyur cig

bdag gi dus gsum dge ba 'di yi mthus/ /bdag cag dpon slob dus 'dir tshe ring zhing / /bsam don kun 'grub bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /de de bzhin du gyur cig de las gzhan du nam yang ma gyur cig sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ nged rang gi 'dra 'bag yid bzhin nor bu'i gzungs gzhug gi dkar chag PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
